collision_note: static solids = concave triangleMesh; moving solids = decimated convexHull except the cycloid rotor/output carrier authored as convexDecomposition. AUG_SHAFT and CROSS_FEED_SHAFT use short axial convex hulls of actual STEP-derived fine STL vertices, rather than full-flight hulls that close screw valleys. Fragment contacts remain collidable; hull contact is not proof of transfer.

collision_groups.Art: all articulation links (IN_SHAFT, S1A, S1B, S2_ECC, S2_CARRIER)
collision_groups.Fit: journal fits / keyed sprockets / gear-mesh partners (BR-, DRV-B*, DRV_SH40, DRV_CHAIN, S1-BPL, S1-BR-CAP, FRONT/REAR supports, bearing envelopes, fixed-ring plates, ring pins)
collision_groups.KinPaddle: PADDLE (pose-driven kinematic worm shaft, VP1 rev 6 chain-driven transfer)
collision_groups.KinAuger: AUGER (pose-driven kinematic screw conveyor at S2Ecc/8, worm:wheel 8:1)
collision_groups.KinCrossFeedFlight: CROSS_FEED_SHAFT RH flight axial hulls, no filtering; fragments live
collision_groups.KinCrossFeedJournal: CROSS_FEED_SHAFT y208..224.75 and y250.25..250.7 journal slices
collision_groups.Belt: two side loops on a common drive/idler shaft
collision_groups.BeltDrive: waisted common drive for the centre lane
collision_groups.BeltIdler: two side loops' waisted east follower
collision_groups.TransferBelt: continuous centre lane rising into AUG

filtered_pairs.Art_x_Fit: journal fits, keyed sprockets and the helical 15T/40T gear mesh: by-design overlap at zero-to-interference clearance in a rigid rig; kinematically driven so contact forces must not act
filtered_pairs.Art_x_KinRotor: rotor orbits/spins inside the articulation envelope by design
filtered_pairs.Art_x_KinRoller: output rollers ride in keyed carrier pins by design
filtered_pairs.Art_x_KinPaddle: worm shaft/sprocket pass inside the articulation envelope by design (chain-driven transfer, ideal constraint)
filtered_pairs.KinPaddle_x_Fit: paddle chain loop wraps the widened S2 12T face and the worm-shaft sprocket by design (12T/12T band)
filtered_pairs.Art_x_KinAuger: auger shaft/flight pass inside the articulation envelope by design (worm-driven conveyor, ideal constraint)
filtered_pairs.KinPaddle_x_KinAuger: PDL_WORM 2-start worm engages the AUG_WHEEL 16T conjugate teeth by design (8:1 worm wheel, ideal constraint)
filtered_pairs.KinAuger_x_Fit: auger journal seats: west bore r5.5 and east boss bore r4.7 vs the flight hull (r5) and shaft - journal fits by design
filtered_pairs.KinRotor_x_KinRoller: cycloid output coupling (rollers ride in rotor windows)
filtered_pairs.KinRotor_x_Fit: rotor vs fixed-ring pins: fixed-ring cycloid engagement by design
filtered_pairs.KinRoller_x_Fit: rollers vs ring plates by design
filtered_pairs.KinCrossFeedJournal_x_CrossFeedBearing: only cross-feed journal slices in the named bearing bores; RH flight vs shell and fragments stays live
filtered_pairs.FeedIdler_x_CrossFeedBearing: idler journal inside named bearing bore
filtered_pairs.FeedIdler_x_PaddleFeedGear: first 12T external gear mesh; ideal opposite-angle kinematics, no tooth-force solver
filtered_pairs.FeedIdler_x_CrossFeedGear: second 12T external gear mesh; ideal same signed cross-feed ratio after two reversals
filtered_pairs.Belt_x_BeltDrive_BeltIdler: stationary belt shell intersects rolling drums at the contact arc, driven by measured S1B kinematics
filtered_pairs.BeltDrive_x_TransferBelt: centre loop wraps the waisted common source drum
filtered_pairs.TransferBelt_x_TransferIdler: centre belt shell wraps its east follower
filtered_pairs.articulation_self_collision: disabled: S1A/S1B cutter hulls interleave by design; hulls cannot represent the hook interleave

contact_filter_table.not_filtered: every probe/fragment vs every collider, including cross-feed screw; cross-feed flight vs static shell and mouth; all other static clearance contacts except named journal bores; no downstream loss suppressed

derived_transfer_spec.note: emit_usd.py-era DERIVED boxes removed — phantom solids sealing the S1 chamber and chute; actual CAD includes CHUTE_BODY + CHUTE_TROUGH_FLOOR_E. path_check.json measures apertures, not connected transport.

probe_spawn.note: 2mm below hopper solid top; lateral spread set by verify_full.py across the mouth cross-section
